claims.claim_text: The indexed Miguel Chamorro is a high-confidence match to the Spanish Republican recruited from Mexico and trained at OSS Area B in 1942.
claims.evidence_excerpt: los cuatro republicanos espanoles: Barrios, Sicre, Tuesta y Chamorro
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The scholarly article says Downes recruited Miguel Chamorro from Mexico, sent the four recruits to Area B, and included Chamorro in the Spanish OSS operations group.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence: the exact distinctive name appears in the official personnel index and in a peer-reviewed account citing a November 14, 1942 Downes letter in RG 226.
claims.temporal_assessment: The article explicitly places recruitment and Area B training in 1942 and the Spanish OSS group by November 1942. It names no pre-OSS employer.
claims.match_notes: The evidence supports identity, Spanish Republican/foreign personnel context, and OSS recruitment/training. Mexico is a place of recruitment, not an employer, and no civilian affiliation is inferred.
